note: 1Click/NEAR Intents has no testnet. Every quote, deposit address and status is a real mainnet object. These files are for offline tests and judging; they are not payments.

tokens.snapshot.json.detail: Five relevant rows from the live GET /v0/tokens response (216 tokens total) recorded 2026-11-09.

quote.dry.base-usdc-near-usdc.json.detail: Live HTTP 201 dry quote, Base USDC to NEAR USDC, 0.15 USDC. Signature verifies with SDK 0.1.26.

quote.live.base-usdc-near-usdc.json.detail: Live HTTP 201 non-dry quote allocating 0x5eFF1eda63DF64B9831483888702e56Ea62Def95. It was never funded. Signature verifies with SDK 0.1.26.

quote.dry.tampered-recipient.json.detail: Recorded dry quote with recipient changed to attacker.near. Signature must fail verification.

status.pending-deposit.json.detail: Live GET /v0/status for the unfunded non-dry quote. PENDING_DEPOSIT, signed quoteResponse verifies.

status.success.near.synthetic.json.detail: Real signed non-dry quoteResponse plus synthetic NEAR-destination swapDetails. The destination tx hash 11111111111111111111111111111111 is NOT a real transaction. No live NEAR-destination SUCCESS sample exists.

status.success.public-btc-sample.json.detail: Key fields from a public live SUCCESS status (ETH USDT to BTC) observed 2026-11-09. quoteResponse is omitted because the recorded excerpt did not include it. explorerUrl was empty.

status.refunded.synthetic.json.detail: Documented-shape REFUNDED response. No live REFUNDED sample was available. Uses the real signed quoteResponse for signature tests.

status.failed.synthetic.json.detail: Documented-shape FAILED response. No live FAILED sample was available.

status.incomplete-deposit.synthetic.json.detail: Documented-shape INCOMPLETE_DEPOSIT response. No live sample was available.

status.known-deposit-tx.synthetic.json.detail: Documented-shape KNOWN_DEPOSIT_TX response. No live sample was available.

status.processing.synthetic.json.detail: Documented-shape PROCESSING response. No live sample was available.

status.unknown.synthetic.json.detail: Undocumented FUTURE_STATUS_NOT_IN_DOCS used to prove fail-closed INCOMPLETE mapping with raw preservation.

near-rpc.view-account.exists.json.detail: NEAR RPC view_account shape for an existing named account.

near-rpc.storage.registered.json.detail: NEAR RPC storage_balance_of result bytes for a registered account.

near-rpc.storage.null.json.detail: NEAR RPC storage_balance_of result bytes for null (not registered).
